'''Devil's Asteroid'''<ref name="Monsters" /> was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]<ref name="Monsters" /> located within the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] of the [[Devil's Asteroid system/Legends|same name]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Devil's Asteroid was first mentioned in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]].<ref name="Monsters" /> [[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in the book is [[Canon|non-canonical]]<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref> with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Legends">{{SW|url=news/the-legendary-star-wars-expanded-universe-turns-a-new-page|text=The Legendary Star Wars Expanded Universe Turns a New Page}}</ref>

However, [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA" /> has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the star systems listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of [[Demon/Legends|Devil's]] Asteroid to be canonical with respect to the Legends continuity.<ref name="Fry" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Devil's Asteroid system in grid square O-2.<ref name="TEA" />

===''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas''===
{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
{{Quote|SPECIAL DATA: recently escaped from Devil's Asteroid; known to carry fusion weapons and disease chambers; laser used in last detonation (family Thanksgiving); 79 previous convictions; no vaccinations|Excerpt from the wanted poster for the "Marauder of Endor"|<ref name="Monsters" />}}
At some point, the<ref name="Monsters" /> [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]]<ref name="Monsters" /><ref name="Gamer 9">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> criminal known as the "[[Marauder of Endor]]" escaped from [[Prison/Legends|imprisonment]] on [[Demon/Legends|Devil's]] Asteroid. That fact was mentioned on a wanted poster for the criminal that was released shortly after his escape.<ref name="Monsters" />
{{Noncanonend}}
